rule: announced_date is blank or not a date
no source names the round stage
no sector label in a source table and no keyword match
no report says where the company is based
one article URL appears more than once in the source records
same company has another round within 45 days
announced_date before 2025-01-01 or in the future
log10(amount) beyond 1.5 x IQR for the stage (stages with at least 10 amounts)
amount below $0.01 Mn or above $2000 Mn
a report's rupee and dollar figures imply a rate more than 10% from the reference rate
reports of one round differ by a factor of about 10, 100 or 1,000
highest and lowest reported amount differ by more than 10%
reports of one round are more than 7 days apart
two detailed sources each name a lead investor and have none in common
two detailed sources state different stages
